requirements.title: Health endpoint returns status and tool count
requirements.text: GET /api/health returns JSON with status 'ok' and tools count as integer.

requirements.title: List tools returns categorized tool listing
requirements.text: GET /api/tools returns JSON with count, categories, and tools array sorted by category then name.

requirements.title: Run calculator returns 400 on invalid JSON body
requirements.text: POST /api/calc with malformed JSON returns 400 with error 'invalid JSON'.

requirements.title: Run calculator returns 400 on invalid sanitized params
requirements.text: POST /api/calc with parameters that fail validation returns 400 with error message from _sanitize_params.

requirements.title: Run calculator returns 400 on calculator domain errors
requirements.text: POST /api/calc with inputs that cause ValueError, ZeroDivisionError, KeyError, or TypeError returns 400 with actionable error message.

requirements.title: Run calculator returns 400 on unexpected calculator exception
requirements.text: POST /api/calc with inputs that cause an unexpected exception returns 400 with generic error 'calculation failed'.

requirements.title: Run calculator returns result on valid calculator and params
requirements.text: POST /api/calc with valid calculator name and parameters returns 200 with calculator name and result.

requirements.title: API NAV returns 400 on invalid scheme code
requirements.text: GET /api/nav with code that is not all digits or longer than 9 characters returns 400 with error 'invalid scheme code'.

requirements.title: API NAV returns 400 on invalid query
requirements.text: GET /api/nav with empty q or q longer than 80 characters returns 400 with error 'query must be 1–80 characters'.
requirements.quote: return JSONResponse({"error": "query must be 1–80 characters"}, status_code=400)

requirements.title: API FX returns 400 on invalid currency codes
requirements.text: GET /api/fx with base or symbols not matching _CCY_RE returns 400 with error 'invalid currency code'.

requirements.title: API Quote returns 400 on invalid symbol
requirements.text: GET /api/quote with symbol not matching _SYMBOL_RE returns 400 with error 'invalid symbol'.

requirements.title: Payload size limit on /api endpoints
requirements.text: POST /api/* with content-length greater than 16384 returns 413 with error 'payload too large'.

requirements.title: Security headers added to every HTTP response
requirements.text: Every HTTP response includes x-content-type-options, referrer-policy, permissions-policy, strict-transport-security, cross-origin-opener-policy, and content-security-policy headers.
